import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4)); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off'); # open L-frame
ax.plot([0,0],[0,1.1], 'k-', lw=3); ax.plot([0,0.4],[0,0], 'k-', lw=3); ax.text(0.05,0.6,'spine Al tube'); ax.text(0.15,0.05,'toe plate hinge down'); ax.plot([0,0],[1.1,1.3],'k--',lw=2); ax.text(0.05,1.2,'telescopic handle up'); ax.plot( -0.15,0.15,'o',ms=20); ax.text(-0.35,0.3,'tri-star cluster'); # folded
ax.plot([1.0,1.0],[0,1.1],'k-',lw=3); ax.plot([1.0,1.05],[0,0.9],'k-',lw=3); ax.text(1.05,0.6,'spine flat'); ax.text(1.05,0.95,'toe folded up'); ax.text(1.05,0.25,'cluster tucked'); ax.text(0.4,1.5,'OPEN L'); ax.text(1.3,1.5,'FOLDED FLAT <1200x600x300mm'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=120)
